SUBJECT: Shanghai Office of the International
Anti-Communist League established

The Shanghai Office of the "International
Anti-Communist League" (國際反共聯盟) commenced
functioning on February 1, 1942, at 99 Chin Ka Fong
(金家坊), West Gate, Nantao. It is reported that
the organization will publish an "Anti-Communist League
Monthly" (國際联盟反共月刊) to propagate anti-communism in
this locality. The Chairman and Vice-Chairman of this
League are Tsu Ding (朱鼎), Woo Zur Chong (胡寿昌)
and Wong Tsung Ming (王極明) respectively. It is
learned that the Headquarters of the organization in
question is established at Tokyo, Japan, and its
branch office is at Nanking with Chow Yoe Chong (周
学昌), Mayor of the Nanking Special Municipality as
the Chairman of the Nanking Branch Office of the League.

This Shanghai Office was reorganized from the
"East Asia Anti-Communist League" (東亚反共同盟會,
which was established by Tsu Ding (mentioned above) in
Lane 93/3 Woo Ka Loong (吳家弄), Pootung, during the
summer of 1938. It was engaged in Anti-Communist and
Anti-Foreign propaganda work, but ceased functioning
during the autumn of 1939 by order of the Nanking
Government. In 1941, when Tsu Ding published the
Shanghai Shih Pao (上海時報) newspaper from 409 East
Seward Road, the League removed its office from
Pootung to the Small East Gate, Nantao, and still remained
inactive. Following the outbreak of the Pacific War,
the league again removed to the present address, No.99
Ching Ka Fong (金家坊), West Gate, Nantao, and

报告

S. 1. 特务科人员。档案号.................... 日期...1942年2月12日....

主题：国际反共联盟上海办事处成立

“国际反共联盟”（國際反共聯盟）上海办事处于1942年2月1日在南市西门金家坊99号开始运作。据报，该组织将出版一份《国际联盟反共月刊》（國際联盟反共月刊），以在此地宣传反共思想。该联盟的主席和副主席分别为朱鼎（Tsu Ding）、胡寿昌（Woo Zur Chong）和王極明（Wong Tsung Ming）。据悉，该组织的总部设在日本东京，其分支机构设在南京，由南京特别市市长周学昌（Chow Yoe Chong）担任该联盟南京办事处主席。

此上海办事处是由“东亚反共同盟会”（東亚反共同盟會）改组而成，后者由上述朱鼎于1938年夏季在浦东吴家弄93/3号建立。该组织从事反共和反外宣传工作的，但于1939年秋季奉南京政府命令停止活动。1941年，当朱鼎在西华德路409号出版《上海时报》（上海時報）报纸时，该联盟将其办事处从浦东迁至南市小东门，但仍处于不活动状态。太平洋战争爆发后，该联盟再次迁至现址，即南市西门金家坊99号，并采用“国际...反共...联盟上海办事处”的名称
